episodes.title: Andy Ngo: The Charles Manson Family Were Trans and More Weird
episodes.description:
Andy Ngo is a gay Asian son of immigrants. He's also been branded a neo-Nazi and white supremacist to discredit his work.

In this interview, Andy Ngo — author of The Zizians: Inside a Trans Death Cult — discusses the Zizians, trans violence, his brutal attack in Portland, and what it was like to be outcast from LGBT media for reporting on it. Most of his interviews only cover the cult. This one gets personal about why he reports the way he does, and what it cost him.

Hey guys, Michael Pezzullo here. I'm a gay men's therapist in West Hollywood. I say the things about gay men no therapist will say — to be free, and to follow your own voice.

👉 Buy Andy's Book: https://www.ngocomment.com
👉 Work With Michael: https://www.michaelpezzullo.com/work-with-me
